content: {"question":"What is the purpose of the Learning & Development team's learning initiatives?","answer":"They aim to foster a culture of curiosity and continual learning by providing a forum for team members to learn about activities in the learning space and hear from leaders on various leadership topics.","evidence":"The Learning & Development team is rolling out learning programs to enable a culture of curiosity and continual learning. The learning initiatives are intended to provide a forum for team members to come together to learn about all of the activities taking place in the learning space, as well as hear from leaders internally and externally on various leadership topics."}
